Market today: Tech is getting hammered, and the headlines about the US deficit and Treasury yields are the real driver. This is bad news for your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin.
Your holdings: CRWD (-29.99%), QQQ (-0.68%), SMH (-15.18%), SMCI (-27.92%), SNOW (-8.3%), MU (-34.55%), SOXL (-58.32%), SPAL (-37.46%), QQQI (-4.37%) are all marked SELL. These are all in the red and need attention. MU, SOXL, and SPAL are leveraged ETFs that are bleeding you dry.
Watch: Keep an eye on the broader market sentiment and any news that could impact tech valuations.
Bottom line: Your concentrated tech book is under pressure; focus on managing risk and cutting losses where necessary.
plays: Trim QQQ and SPY: Both are marked SELL/TRIM and are showing losses. Consider reducing exposure.
Evaluate leveraged ETFs: MU, SOXL, SPAL are down significantly. Assess if further cuts are needed given their decay.
Consider PLTR setup: Scanner shows ACCUMULATE at 185.23-185.04, stop 183.55. This is a potential new buy if you want to add to your PLTR position.
